notes: This bounded reference model carries no wire identifier, no schema $id route, and no receipt digest.
It does not alter, extend, or reinterpret any frozen VSTD wire identifier.
Nothing in this model asserts a cryptographic guarantee. Cryptographic mechanisms named here are inputs whose verification is performed elsewhere and asserted as evidence.

terminology_decision.rationale: The profile never removes identity; it withholds civil identity while retaining cryptographic and authorization coordinates. Calling that 'zero identity' overstates the privacy property and understates the retained coordinates.

terminal_property_results: any REFUTED property makes the record REJECTED
otherwise any CONFLICTED property makes the record CONFLICTED
verdict_aggregation.acceptance_boundary: otherwise authentication and authorization must both be SUPPORTED and every explicitly claimed property must be SUPPORTED or ATTESTED
verdict_aggregation.ancillary_unknowns: UNKNOWN on an unclaimed ancillary property remains visible and does not widen the ACCEPTED_BOUNDED authorization result

prohibited_inferences: a pseudonym implies a distinct actor
a shared pseudonym implies a single actor
two distinct pseudonyms imply two independent actors
an authorization grant implies that authority is currently active
absent revocation evidence implies active authority
absent uniqueness evidence implies Sybil resistance
hashing, redaction, encryption, omission, or pseudonymity alone implies zero identity
disclosure minimization preserves the original claim boundary
a signer is the author of the claim
a relayed or delegated claim is first-party authorship
an absent authorship role means degree zero
a recorded ancestry chain establishes that authority survived every hop
no ancestor marked revoked means every ancestor is valid
a key rotation link merges two key coordinates into one actor
a delegation may carry a scope its ancestor did not hold

attribution.bound_to: pseudonymous coordinate only, never civil identity

unlinkability.reason: This model observes one record at a time and cannot observe the adversary's full correlation surface.

requires: a named escalation authority that can act on the pseudonymous coordinate

confidentiality.reason: Transport and storage confidentiality are outside this record.

authorship_degree.reason: Authorship distance is an assertion about the world outside the record; this model can check it for internal consistency but cannot observe who wrote a claim.

credential_ancestry.reason: The chain records ancestry. It does not by itself establish that authority survived every hop, mirroring the recorded-lineage discipline of VSTD-Graph-1.

rules.statement: A missing coordinate yields UNKNOWN, never a favourable status.
CONFLICTED is terminal for the property and propagates to the record verdict.
Revoked or expired authority is REFUTED, never UNKNOWN.
A shared pseudonymous coordinate cannot supply independent corroboration, but it leaves actor independence UNKNOWN because multiple actors may share one credential.
Distinct pseudonymous coordinates leave both independence and actor-distinctness UNKNOWN.
A minimization request that removes a required public coordinate, whether directly or through a parent path, makes the record unevaluable and is REJECTED.
When freshness is required, an absent challenge coordinate fails closed and a replayed challenge is REFUTED.
A claim boundary may only narrow under minimization; widening is REJECTED.
A key marked compromised for the signing interval REFUTES authentication.
unlinkability is never SUPPORTED by this model; at best it is ASSUMED under declared assumptions.
Authorship degree is asserted, never inferred; an absent role stays UNKNOWN and never defaults to ORIGINATOR.
A relay, delegate, or aggregator that claims origination is REFUTED.
A revoked recorded ancestor REFUTES the chain; authority does not survive delegation from a revoked ancestor.
A delegation whose scope exceeds its ancestor scope is REFUTED.
An unattested link, a chain that misses a declared trust root, or a chain that misses the signing key stays UNKNOWN.
An unattested rotation does not merge two key coordinates into one actor.
A declared degree that disagrees with the recorded chain length is CONFLICTED.
